# external-R-Oxipng paper workload adapter

This directory is a strict adapter scaffold for an external paper macro workload.
It is not performance evidence by itself.

## Contract

- `run_paper_workload.py` delegates to `evaluation/scripts/paper_external_workload_adapter.py`.
- The adapter refuses to emit timing unless `workload_config.json` or `workload_config.local.json` exists and sets `configured=true`.
- A real config must point at a real benchmark checkout and a command that selects dataset, benchmark, allocator, variant, and run index.
- The command/env/cwd template must keep selector placeholders for dataset, benchmark, allocator, variant, and run index so each paper cell is actually selected.
- The benchmark command must print a JSON object with a finite timing field such as `seconds`; set `benchmark_owned_json=true` only when that JSON comes from the benchmark harness rather than a generic wall-clock wrapper.

Benchmarks matched by the current bundle rule: `R-Oxipng*`.


## Paper source hint

- Project: `Oxipng`
- Paper version: `v4.0.3`
- Upstream URL: `https://github.com/shssoichiro/oxipng`

Start by copying `workload_config.template.json` to `workload_config.json`, filling in the real checkout path and command, then run the bundle audit with dry-run probing.

## Current local audit

The active `workload_config.local.json` is configured for a cargo-bench JSON bridge over Oxipng `v4.0.3`, but it is still `claim_grade=false`. The current guarded schedule is target/leaf-split rather than monolithic: `generate-roxipng-paper-plan --split-cargo-targets --split-libtest-target zopfli --target-timeout zopfli=900 --target-leaf-timeout zopfli_4_bits_strategy_0=1200 --target-leaf-timeout zopfli_8_bits_strategy_0=2400 --target-leaf-timeout zopfli_16_bits_strategy_0=3600 --run-id roxipng-paper-plan-target-leaf-zopfli-timeout-tuned-20260613b --dry-run-probe --dry-run-probe-limit 10` refreshes `evaluation/results/roxipng_paper_plan.json` and `evaluation/results/roxipng_paper_plan_audit.json` with 350 workloads, 210 paper-cell planned runs, 2100 planned cell-target fragment runs, 1050/1050 planned zopfli cell-target-leaf fragment runs, 35/35 covered cells, 6/6 selected cargo targets, 97 expected libtest leaves, and zero dry-run probe failures in the sampled probe set. The plan keeps the zopfli target default at 900s but records per-leaf overrides for measured long-tail leaves (`zopfli_4_bits_strategy_0=1200`, `zopfli_8_bits_strategy_0=2400`, `zopfli_16_bits_strategy_0=3600`) so shorter leaves are not accidentally inflated by a target-wide timeout. The latest folded matrix, `audit-roxipng-claim-matrix --run-id roxipng-claim-matrix-after-hugepage-metadata-scudo-run2-full-surface-20260620a`, publishes `evaluation/results/roxipng_claim_matrix_audit.json` with 810 R-Oxipng diagnostic sample records across 156 sample sources. Default/default-performance `unialloc`, `jemalloc`, `mimalloc`, `tcmalloc`, `snmalloc`, Darwin-fallback `ptmalloc`, and Scudo-System-fallback `scudo` now each have run indexes 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 full-surface, all 6 cargo targets, and all 97 libtest leaves; `hugepage_metadata/unialloc`, `hugepage_metadata/jemalloc`, `hugepage_metadata/mimalloc`, and `hugepage_metadata/tcmalloc` also have run indexes 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 full-surface with no missing surface run indexes, while `hugepage_metadata/snmalloc` has run indexes 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 full-surface with no missing surface run indexes, and `hugepage_metadata/ptmalloc` now has surface-complete run indexes 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 with no missing surface run indexes, and `hugepage_metadata/scudo` now has surface-complete run indexes 1 and 2 with missing surface run indexes 3, 4, 5, and 6. The latest hugepage metadata comparator run is isolated at `evaluation/raw/roxipng-hugepage-metadata-scudo-run2-full-surface-20260620a/paper-performance.samples.jsonl` with shard audit `evaluation/results/roxipng_hugepage_metadata_scudo_run2_full_surface_shard_audit_20260620a.json`.
